description: Single-story steel frame static analysis with YJK
message: Use YJK to run static analysis for a single-story single-bay steel frame with a 6m span and 4.5m height. Apply only a 48kN/m roof beam line load, derived from an 8kN/m2 roof load over a 6m tributary width; do not also apply the source area load.

assertions.description: The agent must clearly explain that the requested commercial adapter cannot execute the supplied canonical 2-D model and request a genuine 3-D model or an explicitly supported alternative, without reporting numerical results.
